upgradeCards.name: "Chopper"
upgradeCards.text:
You may perform actions even while you are stressed.

After you perform an action while you are stressed, suffer 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: "Chopper"
upgradeCards.text: Action: Discard 1 other equipped Upgrade card to recover 1 shield.

upgradeCards.name: "Genius"
upgradeCards.text: After you reveal and execute a maneuver, if you did not overlap a ship, you may discard 1 of your equipped [Bomb] Upgrade cards without the "Action:" header to drop the corresponding bomb token.

upgradeCards.name: "Gonk"
upgradeCards.text:
Action: Place 1 shield token on this card.

Action: Remove 1 shield token from this card to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

upgradeCards.name: "Heavy Scyk" Interceptor
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [Cannon], [Torpedo] or [Missile] upgrade icon.

Increase your hull value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: "Hot Shot" Blaster
upgradeCards.text: Attack: Discard this card to attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

upgradeCards.name: "Leebo"
upgradeCards.text: Action: Perform a free boost action. Then receive 1 ion token.

upgradeCards.name: "Light Scyk" Interceptor
upgradeCards.text: All Damage cards dealt to you are dealt faceup. You may treat all bank maneuvers ([Bank Left] or [Bank Right]) as green maneuvers. You cannot equip Modification upgrades.

upgradeCards.name: "Mangler" Cannon
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

When attacking, you may change 1 of your [Hit] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: "Zeb" Orrelios
upgradeCards.text: Enemy ships inside your firing arc that you are touching are not considered to be touching you when either you or they activate during the Combat phase.

upgradeCards.name: 4-LOM
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, during the "Modify Attack Dice" step, you may receive 1 ion token to choose 1 of the defender's focus or evade tokens. That token cannot be spent during this attack.

upgradeCards.name: A Score to Settle
upgradeCards.text:
During setup, before the "Place Forces" step, choose 1 enemy ship and assign the "A Debt to Pay" Condition card to it.

When attacking a ship that has the "A Debt to Pay" Condition card, you may change 1 [Focus] result to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: A-wing Test Pilot
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains 1 [Elite] upgrade icon.

You cannot equip 2 of the same [Elite] Upgrade cards. You cannot equip this if your pilot skill value is "1" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Accuracy Corrector
upgradeCards.text:
When attacking, during the “Modify Attack Dice” step, you may cancel all of your dice results. Then, you may add 2 [Hit] results to your roll.

Your dice cannot be modified again during this attack.

upgradeCards.name: Adaptability (+1)
upgradeCards.text: Increase your pilot skill value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: Adaptability (-1)
upgradeCards.text: Decrease your pilot skill value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: Adaptive Ailerons
upgradeCards.text: Immediately before you reveal your dial, if you are not stressed, you must execute a white ([Bank Left] 1), ([Straight] 1), or ([Bank Right] 1) maneuver.

upgradeCards.name: Admiral Ozzel
upgradeCards.text: Energy: You may remove up to 3 shields from your ship. For each shield removed, gain 1 energy.

upgradeCards.name: Adrenaline Rush
upgradeCards.text: When you reveal a red maneuver, you may discard this card to treat that maneuver as a white maneuver until the end of the Activation phase.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Ailerons
upgradeCards.text:
Treat your ([Bank Left] 3) and ([Bank Right] 3) maneuvers as white.

Immediately before you reveal your dial, if you are not stressed, you must execute a white ([Bank Left] 1), ([Straight] 1), or ([Bank Right] 1) maneuver.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Cloaking Device
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack, you may perform a free cloak action.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Homing Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, deal 1 faceup Damage card to the defender. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Optics
upgradeCards.text:
You cannot have more than 1 focus token.

During the End phase, do not remove an unused focus token from your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Proton Torpedoes
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

You may change up to 3 of your blank results to [Focus] results.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Sensors
upgradeCards.text:
Immediately before you reveal your maneuver, you may perform 1 free action.

If you use this ability, you must skip your "Perform Action" step during this round.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced SLAM
upgradeCards.text: After performing a SLAM action, if you did not overlap an obstacle or another ship, you may perform a free action on your action bar.

upgradeCards.name: Advanced Targeting Computer
upgradeCards.text: When attacking with your primary weapon, if you have a target lock on the defender, you may add 1 [Critical Hit] result to your roll. If you do, you cannot spend target locks during this attack.

upgradeCards.name: Agent Kallus
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the first round, choose 1 enemy small or large ship. When attacking or defending against that ship, you may change 1 of your [Focus] results to a [Hit] or [Evade] result.

upgradeCards.name: Alliance Overhaul
upgradeCards.text: When attacking with a primary weapon from your primary firing arc, you may roll 1 additional attack die. When attacking from your auxiliary firing arc, you may change 1 of your [Focus] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Andrasta
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains two additional [Bomb] upgrade icons.

upgradeCards.name: Anti-Pursuit Lasers
upgradeCards.text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver that causes it to overlap your ship, roll 1 attack die.  On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, the enemy ship suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: ARC Caster
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship. If this attack hits, you must choose 1 other ship at Range 1 of the defender to suffer 1 damage.

Then flip this card.

upgradeCards.name: ARC Caster (Recharging)
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may receive a weapons disabled token to flip this card.

upgradeCards.name: Assailer
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if the targeted section has a reinforce token, you may change 1 [Focus] result to a [Evade] result.

upgradeCards.name: Assault Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, each other ship at Range 1 of the defender suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Attanni Mindlink
upgradeCards.text: Each time you are assigned a focus or stress token, each other friendly ship with Attanni Mindlink must also be assigned the same type of token if it does not already have one.

upgradeCards.name: Autoblaster
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

Your [Hit] results cannot be canceled by defense dice.

The defender may cancel [Critical Hit] results before [Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Autoblaster Turret
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

Your [Hit] results cannot be canceled by defense dice. The defender may cancel [Critical Hit] results before [Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Automated Protocols
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, after you perform an action that is not a recover or reinforce action, you may spend 1 energy to perform a free recover or reinforce action.

upgradeCards.name: Autothrusters
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if you are inside the attacker’s firing arc beyond Range 2 or outside the attacker’s firing arc, you may change 1 of your blank results to a [Evade] result. You can equip this card only if you have the [Boost] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Azmorigan
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the End phase, you may spend 1 energy to replace a faceup [Crew] or [Team] Upgrade card you have equipped with another Upgrade card of the same type of equal or fewer squad points.

upgradeCards.name: B-wing/E2
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Crew] upgrade icon.

upgradeCards.name: Backup Shield Generator
upgradeCards.text: At the end of each round, you may spend 1 energy to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

upgradeCards.name: Baze Malbus
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may immediately perform a primary weapon attack against a different ship. You cannot perform another attack this round.

upgradeCards.name: BB-8
upgradeCards.text: When you reveal a green maneuver, you may perform a free barrel roll action.

upgradeCards.name: Bistan
upgradeCards.text: When attacking at Range 1-2, you may change 1 of your [Hit] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Black Market Slicer Tools
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose a stressed enemy ship at Range 1-2 and roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, remove 1 stress token and deal it 1 facedown Damage card.

upgradeCards.name: Black One
upgradeCards.text: After you perform a boost or barrel roll action, you may remove 1 enemy target lock from a friendly ship at Range 1. You cannot equip this card if your pilot skill is "6" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Blaster Turret
upgradeCards.text: Attack (focus): Spend 1 focus token to perform this attack against 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

upgradeCards.name: Boba Fett
upgradeCards.text: After performing an attack, if the defender was dealt a faceup Damage card, you may discard this card to choose and discard 1 of the defender's Upgrade cards.

upgradeCards.name: Bodhi Rook
upgradeCards.text: When you acquire a target lock, you can lock onto an enemy ship at Range 1-3 of any friendly ship.

upgradeCards.name: Bodyguard
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may spend a focus token to choose a friendly ship at Range 1 with higher pilot skill than you. Increase its agility value by 1 until the end of the round.

upgradeCards.name: Bomb Loadout
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Bomb] icon.

upgradeCards.name: Bombardier
upgradeCards.text: When dropping a bomb, you may use the ([Straight] 2) template instead of the ([Straight] 1) template.

upgradeCards.name: Bomblet Generator
upgradeCards.text:
When you reveal your maneuver, you may drop 1 bomblet token.

This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

upgradeCards.name: BoShek
upgradeCards.text: When a ship you are touching activates, you may look at its chosen maneuver. If you do, its owner must rotate the dial to an adjacent maneuver. The ship can reveal and execute that maneuver even while stressed.

upgradeCards.name: Bossk
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, if you are not stressed, you must receive 1 stress token. Then assign 1 focus token to your ship and acquire a target lock on the defender.

upgradeCards.name: Breach Specialist
upgradeCards.text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card, you may spend 1 reinforce token to flip it facedown (without resolving its effect). If you do, until the end of the round, when you are dealt a faceup Damage card, flip it facedown (without resolving its effect).

upgradeCards.name: Bright Hope
upgradeCards.text: A reinforce token assigned to your fore section acts as 2 [Evade] results (instead of one).

upgradeCards.name: Broadcast Array
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains the [Jam] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Broken Horn
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if you have a reinforce token, you may add 1 additional [Evade] result. If you do, after defending, discard your reinforce token.

upgradeCards.name: BTL-A4 Y-wing
upgradeCards.text: You cannot attack ships outside your firing arc. After you perform a primary weapon attack, you may immediately perform an attack with a [Turret] secondary weapon.

upgradeCards.name: Burnout SLAM
upgradeCards.text:
Your action bar gains the [SLAM] action icon.

After you perform a SLAM action, discard this card.

upgradeCards.name: C-3PO
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, before you roll 1 or more defense dice, you may guess aloud a number of [Evade] results.  If you roll that many [Evade] results (before modifying dice), add 1 [Evade] result.

upgradeCards.name: Cad Bane
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Bomb] upgrade icon. Once per round, when an enemy ship rolls attack dice due to a friendly bomb detonating, you may choose any number of [Focus] and blank results. It must reroll those results.

upgradeCards.name: Calculation
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your [Focus] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Captain Needa
upgradeCards.text: If you overlap an obstacle during the Activation phase, do not suffer 1 faceup damage card. Instead, roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, suffer 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Captain Rex
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may assign 1 focus token to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Captured TIE
upgradeCards.text: Enemy ships with a pilot skill value lower than yours cannot declare you as the target of an attack. After you perform an attack or when you are the only remaining friendly ship in play, discard this card.

upgradeCards.name: Carlist Rieekan
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Activation phase, you may discard this card to treat each friendly ship's pilot skill value as "12" until the end of the phase.

upgradeCards.name: Cassian Andor
upgradeCards.text: At the end of the Planning phase, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1-2. Guess aloud that ship's bearing and speed, then look at its dial. If you are correct, you may rotate your dial to another maneuver.

upgradeCards.name: Chardaan Refit
upgradeCards.text: This card has a negative squad point cost.

upgradeCards.name: Chewbacca
upgradeCards.text:
When you are dealt a Damage card, you may immediately discard that card and recover 1 shield.

Then, discard this Upgrade card.

upgradeCards.name: Cikatro Vizago
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the End phase, you may discard this card to replace a faceup [Illicit] or [Cargo] Upgrade card you have equipped with another Upgrade card of the same type of equal or fewer squad points.

upgradeCards.name: Cloaking Device
upgradeCards.text:
Action: Perform a free cloak action.

At the end of each round, roll 1 attack die. On a [Focus] result, discard this card, then decloak or discard your cloak token.

upgradeCards.name: Cluster Bombs
upgradeCards.text: After defending, you may discard this card. If you do, each other ship at Range 1 of the defending section rolls 2 attack dice, suffering all damage ([Hit]) and critical damage ([Critical Hit]) rolled.

upgradeCards.name: Cluster Mines
upgradeCards.text:
Action: Discard this card to drop 1 cluster mine token set.

When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps a cluster mine token, that token detonates.

upgradeCards.name: Cluster Missiles
upgradeCards.text: Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack twice.

upgradeCards.name: Collision Detector
upgradeCards.text:
When performing a boost, barrel roll, or decloak, your ship and maneuver template can overlap obstacles.

When rolling for obstacle damage, ignore all [Critical Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Combat Retrofit
upgradeCards.text: Increase your hull value by 2 and your shield value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: Comm Relay
upgradeCards.text:
You cannot have more than 1 evade token.

During the End phase, do not remove an unused evade token from your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Comms Booster
upgradeCards.text: Energy: Spend 1 energy to remove all stress tokens from a friendly ship at Range 1-3. Then assign 1 focus token to that ship.

upgradeCards.name: Concord Dawn Protector
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if you are inside the attacker's firing arc and at Range 1 and the attacker is inside your firing arc, add 1 [Evade] result.

upgradeCards.name: Concussion Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

You may change 1 of your blank results to a [Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Conner Net
upgradeCards.text:
Action: Discard this card to drop 1 Conner net token.

When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps this token, this token detonates.

upgradeCards.name: Construction Droid
upgradeCards.text: When you perform a recover action, you may spend 1 energy to discard 1 facedown Damage card.

upgradeCards.name: Contraband Cybernetics
upgradeCards.text: When you become the active ship during the Activation phase, you may discard this card and receive 1 stress token. If you do, until the end of the round, you may perform actions and red maneuvers even while you are stressed.

upgradeCards.name: Cool Hand
upgradeCards.text: When you receive a stress token, you may discard this card to assign 1 focus or evade token to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Countermeasures
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may discard this card to increase your agility value by 1 until the end of the round. Then you may remove 1 enemy target lock from your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Courier Droid
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the "Place Forces" step, you may choose to treat your pilot skill value as "0" or "8" until the end of the step.

upgradeCards.name: Crack Shot
upgradeCards.text: When attacking a ship inside your firing arc, at the start of the 'Compare Results' step, you may discard this card to cancel 1 of the defender's [Evade] results.

upgradeCards.name: Crossfire Formation
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if there is at least 1 other friendly Resistance ship at Range 1-2 of the attacker, you may add one [Focus] result to your roll.

upgradeCards.name: Cruise Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (Target Lock): Discard this card to perform this attack.

You may roll additional attack dice equal to the speed of the maneuver you executed this round, to a maximum of 4 additional dice.

upgradeCards.name: Daredevil
upgradeCards.text: Action: Execute a white ([Turn Left] 1) or ([Turn Right] 1) maneuver. Then, receive 1 stress token. Then, if you do not have the [Boost] action icon, roll 2 attack dice. Suffer any damage ([Hit]) and any critical damage ([Critical Hit]) rolled.

upgradeCards.name: Darth Vader
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack against an enemy ship, you may suffer 2 damage to cause that ship to suffer 1 critical damage.

upgradeCards.name: Dash Rendar
upgradeCards.text:
You may perform attacks while overlapping an obstacle.

Your attacks cannot be obstructed.

upgradeCards.name: Dauntless
upgradeCards.text: After you execute a maneuver that causes you to overlap another ship, you may perform 1 free action. Then receive 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Dead Man's Switch
upgradeCards.text: When you are destroyed, each ship at Range 1 suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Deadeye
upgradeCards.text:
You may treat the Attack (target lock): header as Attack (focus):.

When an attack instructs you to spend a target lock, you may spend a focus token instead.

upgradeCards.name: Death Troopers
upgradeCards.text: After another friendly ship at Range 1 becomes the defender, if you are inside the attacker's firing arc at Range 1-3, the attacker receives 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Debris Gambit
upgradeCards.text: Action: Assign 1 evade token to your ship for each obstacle at Range 1, to a maximum of 2 evade tokens.

upgradeCards.name: Decoy
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Exchange your pilot skill with that ship's pilot skill until the end of the phase.

upgradeCards.name: Deflective Plating
upgradeCards.text: When a friendly bomb token detonates, you may choose not to suffer its effects. If you do, roll an attack die. on a [Hit] result, discard this card.

upgradeCards.name: Dengar
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die. If the defender is a unique pilot, you may instead reroll up to 2 attack dice.

upgradeCards.name: Determination
upgradeCards.text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card with the Pilot trait, discard it immediately without resolving its effect.

upgradeCards.name: Director Krennic
upgradeCards.text: During setup, before the "Place Forces" step, assign the "Optimized Prototype" Condition to a friendly Galactic Empire ship with 3 or fewer shields.

upgradeCards.name: Docking Clamps
upgradeCards.text: You may dock up to 4 TIE fighters, TIE Interceptors, TIE bombers, or TIE Advanced to this ship. All of these ships must have the same ship type.

upgradeCards.name: Dodonna's Pride
upgradeCards.text: When you perform a coordinate action, you may choose 2 friendly ships (instead of 1).  Those ships may each perform 1 free action.

upgradeCards.name: Dorsal Turret
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

If the target of this attack is at Range 1, roll 1 additional attack die.

upgradeCards.name: Draw Their Fire
upgradeCards.text: When a friendly ship at Range 1 is hit by an attack, you may suffer 1 of the uncanceled [Critical Hit] results instead of the target ship.

upgradeCards.name: Dual Laser Turret
upgradeCards.text: Attack (Energy): Spend 1 energy from this card to perform this attack against 1 ship (even a ship outside of your firing arc).

upgradeCards.name: Dutyfree
upgradeCards.text: When performing a jam action, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1-3 (instead of at Range 1-2).

upgradeCards.name: Electronic Baffle
upgradeCards.text: When you receive a stress token or an ion token, you may suffer 1 damage to discard that token.

upgradeCards.name: Elusiveness
upgradeCards.text:
When defending, you may receive 1 stress token to choose 1 attack die. The attacker must reroll that die.

If you have at least 1 stress token, you cannot use this ability.

upgradeCards.name: EM Emitter
upgradeCards.text: When you obstruct an attack, the defender rolls 3 additional defense dice (instead of 1).

upgradeCards.name: EMP Device
upgradeCards.text: During the Combat phase, instead of performing any attacks, you may discard this card to assign 2 ion tokens to each ship at Range 1.

upgradeCards.name: Emperor Palpatine
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, before a friendly ship rolls dice, you may name a die result. After rolling, you must change 1 of your dice results to the named result. That die result cannot be modified again.

upgradeCards.name: Enforcer
upgradeCards.text: After defending, if the attacker is inside your bullseye firing arc, it receives 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Engine Booster
upgradeCards.text: Immediately before you reveal your maneuver dial, you may spend 1 energy to execute a white ([Straight] 1) maneuver.  You cannot use this ability if you would overlap another ship.

upgradeCards.name: Engine Upgrade
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains the [Boost] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Engineering Team
upgradeCards.text: During the Activation phase, when you reveal a [Straight] maneuver, gain 1 additional energy during the "Gain Energy" step.

upgradeCards.name: Enhanced Scopes
upgradeCards.text: During the Activation phase, treat your pilot skill value as "0".

upgradeCards.name: Expanded Cargo Hold
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when you would be dealt a faceup Damage card, you may draw that card from either the fore or aft Damage deck.

upgradeCards.name: Experimental Interface
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, after you perform an action, you may perform 1 free action from an equipped Upgrade card with the "Action:" header. Then receive 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Expert Handling
upgradeCards.text: Action: Perform a free barrel roll action. If you do not have the [Barrel Roll] action icon, receive 1 stress token. You may then remove 1 enemy target lock from your ship

upgradeCards.name: Expertise
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may change all of your [Focus] results to [Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Expose
upgradeCards.text: Action: Until the end of the round, increase your primary weapon value by 1 and decrease your agility value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: Extra Munitions
upgradeCards.text: When you equip this card, place 1 ordnance token on each equipped [Torpedo], [Missile], and [Bomb] Upgrade card. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 ordnance token on that card instead.

upgradeCards.name: Ezra Bridger
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you are stressed, you may change 1 of your [Focus] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Fearlessness
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you are inside the defender's firing arc at Range 1 and the defender is inside your firing arc, you may add 1 [Hit] result to your roll.

upgradeCards.name: Feedback Array
upgradeCards.text: During the Combat phase, instead of performing any attacks, you may receive 1 ion token and suffer 1 damage to choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1. That ship suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Finn
upgradeCards.text: When attacking with a primary weapon or defending, if the enemy ship is inside your firing arc, you may add 1 blank result to your roll.

upgradeCards.name: Fire-Control System
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack, you may acquire a target lock on the defender.

upgradeCards.name: First Order Vanguard
upgradeCards.text:
When attacking, if the defender is the only ship in your firing arc at Range 1-3, you may reroll 1 attack die.

When defending, you may discard this card to reroll all of your defense dice.

upgradeCards.name: Flechette Cannon
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and, if the defender is not stressed, it also receives 1 stress token. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Flechette Torpedoes
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Discard this card and spend your target lock to perform this attack.

After you perform this attack, the defender receives 1 stress token if its hull value is "4" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Fleet Officer
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose up to 2 friendly ships within Range 1-2 and assign 1 focus token to each of those ships. Then receive 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Flight Instructor
upgradeCards.text: When defending, you may reroll 1 of your [Focus] results.  If the attacker's pilot skill value is "2" or lower, you may reroll 1 of your blank results instead.

upgradeCards.name: Flight-Assist Astromech
upgradeCards.text:
You cannot attack ships outside your firing arc.

After you execute a maneuver, if you did not overlap a ship or obstacle and there are no enemy ships inside your firing arc at Range 1-3, you may perform a free boost or barrel roll action.

upgradeCards.name: Frequency Jammer
upgradeCards.text: When you perform a jam action, choose 1 enemy ship that does not have a stress token and is at Range 1 of the jammed ship. The chosen ship receives 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: General Hux
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose up to 3 friendly ships at Range 1-2. Assign 1 focus token to each of those ships and assign the "Fanatical Devotion" Condition card to 1 of them. Then receive 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Ghost
upgradeCards.text:
Equip the Phantom title card to a friendly Attack Shuttle and dock it to this ship.

After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy it from your rear guides.

upgradeCards.name: Ghost
upgradeCards.text:
Equip the Phantom II title card to a friendly Sheathipede-class shuttle and dock it to this ship.

After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy it from your rear guides.

upgradeCards.name: Glitterstim
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may discard this card and receive 1 stress token. If you do, until the end of the round, when attacking or defending, you may change all of your [Focus] results to [Hit] or [Evade] results.

upgradeCards.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose another ship at Range 1-4. Either remove 1 focus token from the chosen ship or assign 1 focus token to that ship.

upgradeCards.name: Greedo
upgradeCards.text: The first time you attack each round and the first time you defend each round, the first Damage card dealt is dealt faceup.

upgradeCards.name: Guidance Chips
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when attacking with a [Torpedo] or [Missile] secondary weapon, you may change 1 die result to a [Hit] result (or a [Critical Hit] result if your primary weapon value is "3" or higher).

upgradeCards.name: Gunner
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may immediately perform a primary weapon attack. You cannot perform another attack this round.

upgradeCards.name: Gunnery Team
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when attacking with a secondary weapon, you may spend 1 energy to change 1 of your blank results to a [Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Gyroscopic Targeting
upgradeCards.text: At the end of the Combat phase, if you executed a 3-, 4-, or 5-speed maneuver that round, you may rotate your mobile firing arc.

upgradeCards.name: Han Solo
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you have a target lock on the defender, you may spend that target lock to change all of your [Focus] results to [Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Harpoon Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, after the attack resolves, assign the "Harpooned" Condition to the defender.

upgradeCards.name: Havoc
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [System] and [Salvaged Astromech] upgrade icons and loses the [Crew] upgrade icon.

upgradeCards.text:
After you are destroyed, before you are removed from the play area, you may deploy the Nastah Pup Pilot.

upgradeCards.name: Hull Upgrade

upgradeCards.text: You have the pilot ability of each other friendly ship with the IG-2000 Upgrade card (in addition to your own pilot ability).

upgradeCards.name: IG-88D
upgradeCards.text: You have the pilot ability of each friendly ship with the IG-2000 Upgrade card (in addition to your own pilot ability).

upgradeCards.name: Impetuous
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that destroys an enemy ship, you may acquire a target lock.

upgradeCards.name: Inertial Dampeners

upgradeCards.name: Insatiable Worrt
upgradeCards.text: After your perform the recover action, gain 3 energy.

upgradeCards.name: Inspiring Recruit

upgradeCards.name: Instigator

upgradeCards.name: Intimidation

upgradeCards.name: Ion Bombs

When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 ion bomb token.

This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

upgradeCards.name: Ion Cannon
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and receives 1 ion token. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Ion Cannon Turret

Attack: Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

If this attack hits the target ship, the ship suffers 1 damage and receives 1 ion token. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.text: After you receive an ion token, you may choose an enemy ship at Range 1. If you do, remove that ion token. Then that ship may choose to receive 1 ion token. If it does, discard this card.

upgradeCards.name: Ion Projector
upgradeCards.text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver that causes it to overlap your ship, roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, the enemy ship receives 1 ion token.

upgradeCards.name: Ion Pulse Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage and receives 2 ion tokens. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Ion Torpedoes
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, the defender and each ship at Range 1 of it receives 1 ion token.

upgradeCards.name: Ionization Reactor
upgradeCards.text: Energy: Spend 5 energy from this card and discard this card to cause each other ship at Range 1 to suffer 1 damage and receive 1 ion token.

upgradeCards.name: ISB Slicer
upgradeCards.text: After you perform a jam action against an enemy ship, you may choose a ship at Range 1 of that ship that is not jammed and assign it 1 jam token.

upgradeCards.name: Jabba the Hutt
upgradeCards.text: When you equip this card, place 1 illicit token on each [Illicit] Upgrade card in your squad. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 illicit token on that card instead.

upgradeCards.name: Jaina's Light
upgradeCards.text: When defending, once per attack, if you are dealt a faceup Damage card, you may discard it and draw another faceup Damage card.

upgradeCards.name: Jamming Beam
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

If this attack hits, assign the defender 1 jam token. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Jan Dodonna
upgradeCards.text: When another friendly ship at Range 1 is attacking, it may change 1 of its [Hit] results to a [Critical Hit].

upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when a friendly ship at Range 1-3 performs a focus action or would be assigned a focus token, you may assign that ship an evade token instead.

upgradeCards.name: Juke
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you have an evade token, you may change 1 of the defender's [Evade] results to a [Focus] result.

upgradeCards.name: Jyn Erso
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Assign 1 focus token to that ship for each enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-3. You cannot assign more than 3 tokens in this way.

upgradeCards.name: K4 Security Droid
upgradeCards.text: After executing a green maneuver, you may acquire a target lock.

upgradeCards.name: Kanan Jarrus
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, after a friendly ship at Range 1-2 executes a white maneuver, you may remove 1 stress token from that ship.

upgradeCards.name: Ketsu Onyo
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the End phase, you may choose 1 enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-2. That ship does not remove its tractor beam tokens.

upgradeCards.name: Kyle Katarn
upgradeCards.text: After you remove a stress token from your ship, you may assign a focus token to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Kylo Ren
upgradeCards.text: Action: Assign the "I'll Show You the Dark Side" Condition card to an enemy ship at Range 1-3.

upgradeCards.name: Kylo Ren's Shuttle
upgradeCards.text: At the end of the Combat phase, choose an unstressed enemy ship at Range 1-2. The owner must assign a stress token to it or assign a stress token to another ship at Range 1-2 of you that that player controls.

upgradeCards.name: Lando Calrissian
upgradeCards.text: Action: Roll 2 defense dice. For each [Focus] result, assign 1 focus token to your ship. For each [Evade] result, assign 1 evade token to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Latts Razzi
upgradeCards.text: When defending, you may remove 1 stress token from the attacker to add 1 [Evade] result to your roll.

upgradeCards.name: Leia Organa
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Activation phase, you may discard this card to allow all friendly ships that reveal a red maneuver to treat that maneuver as a white maneuver until the end of the phase.

upgradeCards.name: Lightning Reflexes

upgradeCards.name: Lightweight Frame
upgradeCards.text:
When defending, after rolling defense dice, if there are more attack dice than defense dice, roll 1 additional defense die.

upgradeCards.text: When attacking with a primary weapon or [Cannon] seconday weapon, you may reroll 1 attack die.

upgradeCards.text: When attacking or defending, if there are no other friendly ships at Range 1–2, you may reroll 1 of your blank results.

upgradeCards.name: Luke Skywalker
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, you may immediately perform a primary weapon attack. You may change 1 [Focus] result to a [Hit] result.  You cannot perform another attack this round.

upgradeCards.name: M9-G8

When a ship you have locked is attacking, you may choose 1 attack die. The attacker must reroll that die.

You can acquire target locks on other friendly ships.

upgradeCards.text: After defending, you may acquire a target lock on the attacker.

upgradeCards.name: Marksmanship

upgradeCards.name: Maul
upgradeCards.text:
When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may receive any number of stress tokens to reroll that many attack dice.

After performing an attack that hits, you may remove 1 of your stress tokens.

upgradeCards.text: When attacking at Range 3, you may change 1 of your [Hit] results to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Merchant One

upgradeCards.name: Millennium Falcon
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains the [Evade] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Millennium Falcon
upgradeCards.text: After you execute a 3-speed bank maneuver ([Bank Left] or [Bank Right]), if you are not touching another ship and you are not stressed, you may receive 1 stress token to rotate your ship 180°.

You cannot use this ability if you have any stress tokens.

upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when you assign energy to an equipped Upgrade card, gain 2 energy.

upgradeCards.text: When you equip this card, place 3 ordnance tokens on each other equipped [Bomb] Upgrade card. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 ordnance token on that card instead.

upgradeCards.text: After you execute a red maneuver, you may assign 1 focus token to your ship.

upgradeCards.text:
Increase your agility value by 1.

When you reveal a (0 [Stop]) maneuver, you may rotate your ship 180°.

Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

upgradeCards.text:
When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 proton bomb token.

This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

Attack (focus): Discard this card to perform this attack.

upgradeCards.name: Proton Torpedoes
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Spend your target lock and discard this card to perform this attack.

upgradeCards.text: Action: Discard this card to drop 1 proximity mine token. When a ship's base or maneuver template overlaps this token, this token detonates.

upgradeCards.name: Punishing One
upgradeCards.text: Increase your primary weapon value by 1.

Once per round, after you perform an action, you may perform 1 free action shown in your action bar.

upgradeCards.name: R2 Astromech
upgradeCards.text: You may treat all 1- and 2-speed maneuvers as green maneuvers.

upgradeCards.name: R2-D2
upgradeCards.text: After executing a green maneuver, you may recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

upgradeCards.text: At the end of the End phase, if you have no shields, you may recover 1 shield and roll 1 attack die.  On a [Hit] result, randomly flip 1 of your facedown Damage cards faceup and resolve it.

upgradeCards.name: R2-D6
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [Elite] upgrade icon.

You cannot equip this upgrade if you already have a [Elite] upgrade icon or if your pilot skill value is "2" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: R2-F2
upgradeCards.text: Action: Increase your agility value by 1 until the end of this game round.

upgradeCards.text: Once per round, when attacking with a primary weapon, you may cancel 1 of your [Focus] results during the "Modify Attack Dice" step to assign 1 evade token to your ship.

upgradeCards.text: You can perform actions on your [Torpedo] and [Bomb] Upgrade cards even if you are stressed. After you perform an action in this way, you may discard this card to remove 1 stress token from your ship.

upgradeCards.name: R5-D8

Action: Roll 1 defense die.

upgradeCards.name: R5-K6
upgradeCards.text:
After spending your target lock, roll 1 defense die.

On a [Evade] result, immediately acquire a target lock on that same ship. You cannot spend this target lock during this attack.

upgradeCards.name: R5-P9
upgradeCards.text: At the end of the Combat phase, you may spend 1 of your focus tokens to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

upgradeCards.name: R5-TK
upgradeCards.text:
You can acquire target locks on friendly ships.

You can attack friendly ships.

upgradeCards.name: R5-X3

upgradeCards.text: Once per round when defending, if you have a target lock on the attacker, you may spend the target lock to choose any or all attack dice. The attacker must reroll the chosen dice.

upgradeCards.name: R7-T1
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose an enemy ship at Range 1-2. If you are inside that ship's firing arc, you may acquire a target lock on that ship. Then, you may perform a free boost action.

upgradeCards.name: Rage
upgradeCards.text: Action: Assign 1 focus token to your ship and receive 2 stress tokens. Until the end of the round, when attacking, you may reroll up to 3 attack dice.

upgradeCards.name: Raymus Antilles
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Activation phase, choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1-3. You may look at that ship's chosen maneuver. If the maneuver is white, assign that ship 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Rear Admiral Chiraneau
upgradeCards.text: Action: Execute a white ([Straight] 1) maneuver.

upgradeCards.name: Rebel Captive
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, the first ship that declares you as the target of an attack immediately receives 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Recon Specialist
upgradeCards.text: When you perform a focus action, assign 1 additional focus token to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Reinforced Deflectors
upgradeCards.text: After defending, if you suffered a combination of 3 or more damage and critical damage during the attack, recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

upgradeCards.name: Renegade Refit
upgradeCards.text:
You may equip up to 2 different Modification upgrades.

The squad point cost of your equipped [Elite] upgrades is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

upgradeCards.name: Requiem
upgradeCards.text: When you deploy a ship, treat its pilot skill value as "8" until the end of the round.

upgradeCards.name: Rey
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the End phase, you may place 1 of your ship's focus tokens on this card. At the start of the Combat phase, you may assign 1 of those tokens to your ship.

upgradeCards.name: Rigged Cargo Chute
upgradeCards.text: Action: Discard this card to drop one cargo token.

upgradeCards.name: Royal Guard TIE
upgradeCards.text:
You may equip up to 2 different Modification upgrades (instead of 1).

You cannot equip this card if your pilot skill value is "4" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Ruthlessness
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack that hits, you must choose 1 other ship at Range 1 of the defender (other than yourself). That ship suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Sabine Wren
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Bomb] upgrade icon. Once per round, before a friendly bomb token is removed, choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1 of that token. That ship suffers 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Sabine's Masterpiece
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Crew] and [Illicit] upgrade icons.

upgradeCards.name: Saboteur
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose 1 enemy ship at Range 1 and roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, choose 1 random facedown Damage card assigned to that ship, flip it faceup, and resolve it.

upgradeCards.name: Salvaged Astromech
upgradeCards.text:
When you are dealt a faceup Damage card with the Ship trait, you may immediately discard that card (before resolving its effect).

Then, discard this Upgrade card.

upgradeCards.name: Saturation Salvo
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack with a [Torpedo] or [Missile] secondary weapon that does not hit, each ship at Range 1 of the defender with an agility value lower than the squad point cost of the [Torpedo] or [Missile] Upgrade card must roll 1 attack die and suffer any damage ([Hit]) or critical damage ([Critical Hit]) rolled.

upgradeCards.name: Saw Gerrera
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may suffer 1 damage to change all of your [Focus] results to [Critical Hit] results.

upgradeCards.name: Scavenger Crane
upgradeCards.text: After a ship at Range 1-2 is destroyed, you may choose a discarded [Torpedo], [Missile], [Bomb], [Cannon], [Turret], or Modification Upgrade card that was equipped to your ship and flip it faceup. Then roll 1 attack die. On a blank result, discard Scavenger Crane.

upgradeCards.name: Scrambler Missiles
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Discard this card to perform this attack.

If this attack hits, the defender and each other ship at Range 1 receive 1 jam token. Then cancel all results.

upgradeCards.name: Seismic Charges
upgradeCards.text:
When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 seismic charge token.

This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

upgradeCards.name: Sensor Cluster
upgradeCards.text: When defending, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your blank results to an [Evade] result.

upgradeCards.name: Sensor Jammer
upgradeCards.text:
When defending, you may change 1 of the attacker's [Hit] results into a [Focus] result.

The attacker cannot reroll the die with the changed result.

upgradeCards.name: Sensor Team

upgradeCards.name: Servomotor S-foils (Attack)
upgradeCards.text:

At the start of the Activation phase, you may flip this card.

upgradeCards.name: Servomotor S-foils (Closed)
upgradeCards.text:
Reduce your primary attack value by 1. Your action bar gains [Boost]. Treat your ([Bank Left] 2) and ([Bank Right] 2) maneuvers as green.

At the start of the Activation phase, you may flip this card.

upgradeCards.name: Shield Projector
upgradeCards.text: When an enemy ship is declaring either a small or large ship as the target of its attack, you may spend 3 energy to force that ship to target you if possible.

upgradeCards.name: Shield Technician
upgradeCards.text: When you perform a recover action, instead of spending all of your energy, you can choose any amount of energy to spend.

upgradeCards.name: Shield Upgrade
upgradeCards.text: Increase your shield value by 1.

upgradeCards.name: Single Turbolasers
upgradeCards.text: Attack (Energy): Spend 2 energy from this card to perform this attack. The defender doubles his agility value against this attack. You may change 1 of your [Focus] results to a [Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: Slave I
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar gains the [Torpedo] upgrade icon.

upgradeCards.name: Slicer Tools
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose 1 or more ships at Range 1-3 that have a stress token. For each ship chosen, you may spend 1 energy to cause that ship to suffer 1 damage.

upgradeCards.name: Smuggling Compartment
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [Illicit] upgrade icon.

You may equip 1 additional Modification upgrade that costs 3 or fewer squad points.

upgradeCards.name: Snap Shot
upgradeCards.text:
After an enemy ship executes a maneuver, you may perform this attack against that ship.

Attack: Attack 1 ship. You cannot modify your attack dice and cannot attack again this phase.

upgradeCards.name: Spacetug Tractor Array
upgradeCards.text: Action: Choose a ship inside your firing arc at Range 1 and assign a tractor beam token to it. If it is a friendly ship, resolve the effect of the tractor beam token a though it were an enemy ship.

upgradeCards.name: Special Ops Training
upgradeCards.text: When attacking with a primary weapon from your primary firing arc, you may roll 1 additional attack die. If you do not, you may perform an additional attack from your auxiliary firing arc.

upgradeCards.name: Squad Leader
upgradeCards.text:
Action: Choose 1 ship at Range 1-2 that has a lower pilot skill than you.

The chosen ship may immediately perform 1 free action.

upgradeCards.name: ST-321
upgradeCards.text: When acquiring a target lock, you may lock onto any enemy ship in the play area.

upgradeCards.name: StarViper Mk.II
upgradeCards.text:
You may equip up to 2 different Title upgrades.

When performing a barrel roll action, you must use the ([Bank Left] 1) or ([Bank Right] 1) template instead of the ([Straight] 1) template.

upgradeCards.name: Stay on Target
upgradeCards.text: When you reveal a maneuver, you may rotate your dial to another maneuver with the same speed. Treat your maneuver as a red maneuver.

upgradeCards.name: Stealth Device
upgradeCards.text: Increase your agility value by 1. If you are hit by an attack, discard this card.

upgradeCards.name: Stygium Particle Accelerator
upgradeCards.text: When you either decloak or perform a cloak action, you may perform a free evade action.

upgradeCards.name: Supercharged Power Cells
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may discard this card to roll 2 additional attack dice.

upgradeCards.name: Suppressor
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, after you acquire a target lock on an enemy ship, you may remove 1 focus, evade, or blue target lock token from that ship.

upgradeCards.name: Swarm Leader
upgradeCards.text: When performing a primary weapon attack, choose up to 2 other friendly ships that have the defender inside their firing arcs at Range 1-3. Remove 1 evade token from each chosen ship to roll 1 additional attack die for each token removed.

upgradeCards.name: Swarm Tactics
upgradeCards.text:
At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1.

Until the end of this phase, treat the chosen ship as if its pilot skill were equal to your pilot skill.

upgradeCards.name: Synced Turret
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (target lock): Attack 1 ship (even a ship outside your firing arc).

If the defender is inside your primary firing arc, you may reroll a number of attack dice up to your primary weapon value.

upgradeCards.name: Systems Officer
upgradeCards.text: After you execute a green maneuver, choose another friendly ship at Range 1. That ship may acquire a target lock.

upgradeCards.name: Tactical Jammer
upgradeCards.text: Your ship can obstruct enemy attacks.

upgradeCards.name: Tactical Officer
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains [Coordinate].

upgradeCards.name: Tactician
upgradeCards.text: After you perform an attack against a ship inside your firing arc at Range 2, that ship receives 1 stress token.

upgradeCards.name: Tail Gunner
upgradeCards.text: When attacking from your rear-facing auxiliary firing arc, reduce the defender's agility by 1 (to a minimum of "0").

upgradeCards.name: Tantive IV
upgradeCards.text: Your fore section upgrade bar gains 1 additional [Crew] and 1 additional [Team] upgrade icon.

upgradeCards.name: Targeting Astromech
upgradeCards.text: After you execute a red maneuver, you may acquire a target lock.

upgradeCards.name: Targeting Computer
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains the [Target Lock] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Targeting Coordinator
upgradeCards.text: Energy: You may spend 1 energy to choose 1 friendly ship at Range 1-2. Acquire a target lock, then assign the blue target lock token to the chosen ship.

upgradeCards.name: Targeting Scrambler
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Planning phase, you may receive a weapons disabled token to choose a ship at Range 1-3 and assign it the "Scrambled" Condition.

upgradeCards.name: Targeting Synchronizer
upgradeCards.text: When a friendly ship at Range 1-2 is attacking a ship you have locked, the friendly ship treats the "Attack (target lock):" header as "Attack:." If a game effect instructs that ship to spend a target lock, it may spend your target lock instead.

upgradeCards.name: Thermal Detonators
upgradeCards.text:
When you reveal your maneuver dial, you may discard this card to drop 1 thermal detonator token.

This token detonates at the end of the Activation phase.

upgradeCards.name: Threat Tracker
upgradeCards.text: When an enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-2 becomes the active ship during the Combat phase, you may spend your target lock on that ship to perform a free boost or barrel roll action if that action is on your action bar.

upgradeCards.name: Thrust Corrector
upgradeCards.text: When defending, if you have 3 or fewer stress tokens, you may receive 1 stress token to cancel all of your dice results. If you do, add 1 [Evade] result to your roll. Your dice cannot be modified again during this attack. You can equip this Upgrade only if your hull value is "4" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Tibanna Gas Supplies
upgradeCards.text: Energy: You may discard this card to gain 3 energy.

upgradeCards.name: TIE Shuttle
upgradeCards.text: Your upgrade bar loses all [Torpedo], [Missile] and [Bomb] upgrade icons and gains 2 [Crew] upgrade icons. You cannot equip a [Crew] Upgrade card that costs more than 4 squad points.

upgradeCards.name: TIE/D
upgradeCards.text: Once per round, after you perform an attack with a [Cannon] secondary weapon that costs 3 or fewer squad points, you may perform a primary weapon attack.

upgradeCards.name: TIE/v1
upgradeCards.text: After you acquire a target lock, you may perform a free evade action.

upgradeCards.name: TIE/x1
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [System] upgrade icon.

If you equip a [System] upgrade, its squad point cost is reduced by 4 (to a minimum of 0).

upgradeCards.name: TIE/x7
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar loses the [Cannon] and [Missile] upgrade icons.

After executing a 3-, 4-, or 5-speed maneuver, if you did not overlap an obstacle or ship, you may perform a free evade action.

upgradeCards.name: Toryn Farr
upgradeCards.text: Action: Spend any amount of energy to choose that many enemy ships at Range 1-2. Remove all focus, evade, and blue target lock tokens from those ships.

upgradeCards.name: Tractor Beam
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Attack 1 ship.

If this attack hits, the defender receives 1 tractor beam token. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Trajectory Simulator
upgradeCards.text: You may launch bombs using the ([Straight] 5) template instead of dropping them. You cannot launch bombs with the "Action:" header in this way.

upgradeCards.name: Trick Shot
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if the attack is obstructed, you may roll 1 additional attack die.

upgradeCards.name: Twin Ion Engine Mk. II
upgradeCards.text: You may treat all bank maneuvers ([Bank Left] or [Bank Right]) as green maneuvers.

upgradeCards.name: Twin Laser Turret
upgradeCards.text:
Attack: Perform this attack twice (even against a ship outside your firing arc).

Each time this attack hits, the defender suffers 1 damage. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Unguided Rockets
upgradeCards.text:
Attack (focus): Attack 1 ship.

Your attack dice can be modified only by spending a focus token for its standard effect.

upgradeCards.name: Unhinged Astromech
upgradeCards.text: You may treat all 3-speed maneuvers as green maneuvers.

upgradeCards.name: Unkar Plutt
upgradeCards.text: After executing a maneuver that causes you to overlap an enemy ship, you may suffer 1 damage to perform 1 free action.

upgradeCards.name: Vaksai
upgradeCards.text:
The squad point cost of each of your equipped upgrades is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

You may equip up to 3 different Modification upgrades.

upgradeCards.name: Vector
upgradeCards.text: After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy up to 4 docked ships (instead of 2).

upgradeCards.name: Vectored Thrusters
upgradeCards.text: Your action bar gains the [Barrel Roll] action icon.

upgradeCards.name: Veteran Instincts
upgradeCards.text: Increase your pilot skill value by 2.

upgradeCards.name: Virago
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains the [System] and [Illicit] upgrade icons.

You cannot equip this card if your pilot skill value is "3" or lower.

upgradeCards.name: Weapons Engineer
upgradeCards.text:
You may maintain 2 target locks (only 1 per enemy ship).

When you acquire a target lock, you may lock onto 2 different ships.

upgradeCards.name: Weapons Guidance
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your blank results to a [Hit] result.

upgradeCards.name: WED-15 Repair Droid
upgradeCards.text: Action: Spend 1 energy to discard 1 of your facedown Damage cards, or spend 3 energy to discard 1 of your faceup Damage cards.

upgradeCards.name: Wingman
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, remove 1 stress token from another friendly ship at Range 1.

upgradeCards.name: Wired
upgradeCards.text: When attacking or defending, if you are stressed, you may reroll 1 or more of your [Focus] results.

upgradeCards.name: Wookiee Commandos
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, you may reroll your [Focus] results.

upgradeCards.name: Xg-1 Assault Configuration
upgradeCards.text:
Your upgrade bar gains 2 [Cannon] upgrade icons.

You may perform attacks with [Cannon] secondary weapons that cost 2 or fewer squad points even while you have a weapons disabled token.

upgradeCards.name: XX-23 S-Thread Tracers
upgradeCards.text: Attack (Focus): Discard this card to perform this attack. If this attack hits, each friendly ship at Range 1-2 of you may acquire a target lock on the defender. Then cancel all dice results.

upgradeCards.name: Ysanne Isard
upgradeCards.text: At the start of the Combat phase, if you have no shields and at least 1 Damage card assigned to your ship, you may perform a free evade action.

upgradeCards.name: Zuckuss
upgradeCards.text: When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may receive any number of stress tokens to choose an equal number of defense dice. The defender must reroll those dice.
